subject: Request: Syndicus co-brand highlight + short quote — permission to publish
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@syndicus.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@syndicus.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Syndicus co-brand highlight + short quote — permission to publish

Hi Aisha / Carlos,

Hope you’re both well — thanks again for the conversation last week about the Nearline Index rollout. We’d love to feature Syndicus in a short co-branded highlight tile on our site and a one-paragraph customer blurb in an upcoming webinar slide deck.

What we need from you to proceed:
- Written permission to use the Syndicus name and logo in the tile and slide deck
- A short (1-2 sentence) quote we can attribute to Syndicus, or permission to use the excerpt I’ve drafted below
- A vector version of the Syndicus logo and any required usage notes

Draft blurb (for quick review):
"Syndicus reduced Nearline query latency by 4.3x after migrating inference onto Redwood Dedicated, enabling faster analytics for business ops."

I’ve attached a quick draft of the asset with placement examples. Vanessa from marketing is copied for design and brand alignment. If possible, could you reply with redlines or an approval by EOD Thursday (5/27)? We’re aiming to publish the tile the week of June 1.

Attachments: excerpt-draft.docx (draft blurb + mockup), brand-guidelines.pdf (our suggested layout)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0183

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@syndicus.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@syndicus.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Syndicus co-brand highlight + short quote — permission to publish

Hi Karhtik — thanks for the clear note. Happy to help. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Permission: Syndicus is fine with Redwood using our name and logo for the co-branded tile and slide deck, provided the blurb does not reference our internal roadmap or future product capabilities.
2) Quote edit: We prefer this phrasing: 
"Redwood Dedicated helped Syndicus accelerate Nearline query throughput, improving responsiveness for analytics teams."
3) Assets: Attaching our master logo pack (SVG + PNG) — branding team prefers the full-color mark on white or 10% gray.

I’m attaching the logo pack and a short redlines-notes.txt with the brand team's comments. Once you send the final copy back for sign-off, I’ll run it by legal for a quick trademark check. Expect a final sign-off window of 24–48 hours after I receive the final proof.

Attachment: syndicus-logo.zip (SVG/PNG), redlines-notes.txt

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Partnerships | Syndicus
aisha.patel@syndicus.com
+44 20 7946 0123

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Syndicus co-brand highlight + short quote — permission to publish

Thanks for looping me in, Karthik — the assets Aisha sent look clean. Marketing can design the tile and slide this week. Two items before we publish: 

- Brand usage: Aisha’s note about color backgrounds is important — let’s avoid overlaying the full-color mark on dark images. I’ll stick to white/10% gray backgrounds and the clear space rules in their pack.
- Legal check: Olga, can you confirm whether Syndicus’ redline about not mentioning roadmap triggers any additional privacy/disclosure language we should include? Also confirm we’re covered for social promotion (Twitter/LinkedIn).

I uploaded the preliminary mockups to the Drive link below and attached a short design spec. If legal gives the all-clear, I’ll send the final proof back to Aisha for sign-off (per her timeline) and request the signature via DocuSign.

Attachments: brand-guidelines.pdf (marketing spec)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSyndicusAssets

—Vanessa
Sr. Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@syndicus.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@syndicus.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Syndicus co-brand highlight + short quote — permission to publish

Aisha — quick follow up. Vanessa confirmed design is straightforward and Olga is reviewing for trademark/PR language. Assuming legal is good, we’ll send a proof and a short usage agreement (DocuSign) — expected turnaround 24–48 hours from your sign-off.

I’ve attached the updated blurb with Aisha’s preferred phrasing. If that looks good, I’ll route the DocuSign to you and Carlos this afternoon.

Final blurb (for approval):
"Redwood Dedicated helped Syndicus accelerate Nearline query throughput, improving responsiveness for analytics teams."

Attachment: final-blurb-approved-for-proof.docx

Thanks all — aiming to publish the tile on June 2 if we get signatures early next week.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
